title: From The Sunday Read Archives: ‘Alone at Sea’

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日电子报 DealBook 的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的一些领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日于 NYTimes.com 上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用来观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: My name is Liz Weil.
sentences.zh: 我叫莉兹·韦尔。

sentences.en: I'm here in my basement in San Francisco where I work.
sentences.zh: 我现在在旧金山的地下室里，也就是我工作的地方。

sentences.en: And I want to tell you about a story I wrote two years ago.
sentences.zh: 我想和大家分享一个我两年前写的故事。

sentences.en: This is maybe my favorite story I have ever written in my 25 years as a journaliSt.
sentences.zh: 这可能是我25年记者生涯中写过的最喜欢的报道。

sentences.en: It's a profile of a Polish man named Alexander Dova, who, when I reported the story, was 71 years old and had kayaked across the Atlantic three times by himself.
sentences.zh: 这是一篇关于一个名叫亚历山大·多瓦的波兰男人的特写。在我采访他时，他已经71岁了，曾独自划皮划艇横渡大西洋三次。

sentences.en: I've been thinking a lot about him lately because he seemed to me this, like, savant of the existential crisis that is life.
sentences.zh: 我最近一直在想他，因为在我看来，他就像是生活这场存在主义危机的奇才。

sentences.en: He had no illusion that everything is meaningful and enjoyable all the time, but he had this way of flipping his mind to embrace the suffering
sentences.zh: 他不抱有任何“一切时刻都充满意义和乐趣”的幻想，但他有一种方式，能让自己的思维一转，去拥抱苦难，

sentences.en: and embrace what a lot of us would see as the meaninglessness, like essentially being a speck in the universe
sentences.zh: 去拥抱我们许多人视为毫无意义的事物——比如本质上只是宇宙中的一粒尘埃——

sentences.en: and deciding to just rush towards all of it and make himself the tiniest speck in the biggest universe he could possibly imagine there in his kayak, alone in the Atlantic.
sentences.zh: 然后决定径直冲向这一切，在自己想象中最大、而他自己却是最小的那粒尘埃的世界里，独自坐在大西洋的皮划艇上。

sentences.en: So here's my story, Alone at Sea, read by January Lavoie.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的故事《海上的孤独》，由珍妮弗·拉沃伊为您朗读。

sentences.en: When Alexander Dova kayaked into the port in Le Conquet, France, on September 3rd, 2017, he had just completed his third and by far most dangerous solo transatlantic kayak trip.
sentences.zh: 2017年9月3日，当亚历山大·多瓦划着皮划艇驶入法国勒孔凯港时，他刚刚完成了他第三次、也是迄今为止最危险的单人横渡大西洋之旅。

sentences.en: He was a few days shy of his 71st birthday.
sentences.zh: 当时离他的71岁生日只有几天。

sentences.en: He was unaccustomed to wearing pants.
sentences.zh: 他已经习惯了不穿裤子。

sentences.en: He'd been at sea 110 days alone, having last touched land that May at New Jersey's Barnegat Bay.
sentences.zh: 他在大海上独自漂泊了110天，上一次接触陆地还是那年5月在新泽西州的巴尼加特湾。

sentences.en: The trip could have easily ended five days earlier, when Dova was just a few hundred feet off the British coaSt.
sentences.zh: 这次行程本可能在五天前就结束了，当时多瓦距离英国海岸只有几百英尺。

sentences.en: But he had promised himself when he left New Jersey that he would kayak not just to Europe, but to the continent proper.
sentences.zh: 但他离开新泽西时曾向自己保证，他不仅要划到欧洲，还要划到欧洲大陆本土。

sentences.en: So he stayed on the water nearly another week, in the one-meter-wide boat where he'd endured towering waves, in the coffin-like cabin where he spent almost four months
sentences.zh: 因此，他在水上又多待了近一个星期，在那艘只有一米宽的船上，忍受着滔天巨浪；在那间棺材大小的小屋里，度过了近四个月的时光，

sentences.en: not sleeping more than three hours at a stretch, where he severely tried his loved one's patience in order to be lonely, naked, and afraid.
sentences.zh: 连续睡眠从不超过三个小时，为了体验孤独、赤裸和恐惧，他严重考验了亲人们的耐心。

sentences.en: Then he paddled to the French shore.
sentences.zh: 然后，他划桨登上了法国海岸。

sentences.en: Kayaking is an absurd form of long-distance ocean travel.
sentences.zh: 皮划艇远距离海洋旅行是一种荒谬的形式。

sentences.en: All the big muscles in the body are useless.
sentences.zh: 身体里所有的大块肌肉都毫无用处。

sentences.en: A real katorga, says Dova, who is Polish, katorga being the Polish word for forced labor in Siberia.
sentences.zh: “简直是一场苦役（katorga），”波兰人多瓦说，“katorga”是波兰语中西伯利亚苦役的意思。

sentences.en: But by katorga, Dova does not mean an activity he does not wish to do.
sentences.zh: 但多瓦所说的苦役，并不是指他不想做的事情。

sentences.en: What most of us experience as suffering, he repurposes as contrarian self-determination, and that gives him an existential thrill.
sentences.zh: 我们将大多数经历视为痛苦，他却将其重新诠释为反叛性的自我主宰，这带给他一种存在主义的刺激。

sentences.en: Among Dova's bigger regrets in life are the times when he has succumbed, when he has perceived and reacted to suffering in conventional ways.
sentences.zh: 在多瓦一生的遗憾中，比较重大的是那些他曾经屈服的时刻，即他以常规方式感知并对痛苦做出反应的时刻。

sentences.en: For instance, the night in April 1989, when he built a fire in order to make tea and dry his clothes while paddling on the Vistula River near the city of Kvotsk in central Poland.
sentences.zh: 比如1989年4月的一个夜晚，当时他在波兰中部克沃茨克市附近的维斯瓦河上划船，生火是为了煮茶和烘干衣服。

sentences.en: Or the afternoon a week later on that same river, when he succumbed to the temptation of eating pancakes, tomato soup, and rice at the milk bar restaurant,
sentences.zh: 或者一周后在那条河上的一个下午，当他没能抵挡住煎饼、西红柿汤和牛奶吧餐厅米饭的诱惑，

sentences.en: when he should have been at his campsite by his kayak, eating cold, canned goulash in order to condition his body for Arctic temperatures.
sentences.zh: 而那时他本该在皮划艇旁的营地里，吃着冰冷的罐头红烧肉，来让身体适应北极的温度。

sentences.en: Dova had promised himself he would be tougher than all that.
sentences.zh: 多瓦曾向自己保证，他要比这一切都坚强。

sentences.en: Dova maintains that his need to cross the Atlantic in a kayak did not originate within him.
sentences.zh: 多瓦坚称，他要用皮划艇横渡大西洋的需求并不是源于他自己。

sentences.en: With my hand on my heart, it wasn't my idea,
sentences.zh: “摸着良心说，这不是我的主意，”

sentences.en: Dova told me when I met him in Poland in January.
sentences.zh: 今年1月我在波兰见到多瓦时，他对我说道。

sentences.en: Dova doesn't speak much English, so we communicated through a translator.
sentences.zh: 多瓦不会说太多英语，所以我们通过翻译进行交流。

sentences.en: I was infected with a virus.
sentences.zh: “我感染了一种病毒。”

sentences.en: In 2003, when he was already the most seasoned kayaker in Poland, a Polish professor approached him to get advice on his quest to kayak across the Baltic Sea.
sentences.zh: 2003年，当他已经是波兰最有经验的皮划艇运动员时，一位波兰教授找到他，想就皮划艇横渡波罗的海的探险寻求建议。

sentences.en: The professor eventually persuaded Dova to cross the southern Atlantic with him from Ghana to Brazil in separate one-man kayaks,
sentences.zh: 这位教授最终说服多瓦与他一起，分别乘坐单人皮划艇从加纳横渡南大西洋到巴西，

sentences.en: lashing those kayaks together at night to make a platform on which to sleep.
sentences.zh: 并在夜间将这些皮划艇绑在一起，搭成一个睡觉的平台。

sentences.en: The trip was a fiasco.
sentences.zh: 这次旅行是一场彻底的惨败。

sentences.en: Forty-two hours after leaving, they washed up back on the beach.
sentences.zh: 出发42小时后，他们被冲回了海滩。

sentences.en: Dova flew back to Poland, returned to his hometown, Police, in the country's northwest, where he had been managing maintenance and repairs at an enormous chemical factory,
sentences.zh: 多瓦飞回波兰，回到位于该国西北部的家乡波利采——他在那里曾负责管理一个庞大化工厂的维护和修理工作——

sentences.en: and swore off kayaking with a partner ever again.
sentences.zh: 并发誓再也不和同伴一起划皮划艇了。

sentences.en: Then, Dova sketched out a design for a new boat that could make the trip.
sentences.zh: 随后，多瓦草拟了一款能够完成这次航行的全新船只的设计图。

sentences.en: He knew that the kayak needed to be unsinkable, as well as self-righting in the event that it capsized, and that it needed lockers to store food and a cabin in which to sleep.
sentences.zh: 他知道这艘皮划艇必须是不沉的，并且在翻船时能够自动扶正，还需要有储藏食物的舱室和供睡觉的小屋。

sentences.en: Sketch in hand,
sentences.zh: 拿着草图，

sentences.en: Dova drove from Police to Strecin, the regional capital, and approached a yacht builder named Andrei Arminsky.
sentences.zh: 多瓦从波利采开车到区域首府什切青，找到了一位名叫安德烈·阿尔明斯基的游艇建造商。

sentences.en: Arminsky agreed to build the boat, and in spring of 2010,
sentences.zh: 阿尔明斯基同意建造这艘船，并在2010年春天，

sentences.en: Olo, as Dova named his kayak, after his own nickname, Olek, was complete.
sentences.zh: 名为“奥洛（Olo）”的皮划艇完工了，这个名字取自多瓦的昵称“奥莱克（Olek）”。

sentences.en: Dova told his wife that he was going to try to cross the Atlantic again.
sentences.zh: 多瓦告诉他的妻子，他要再次尝试横渡大西洋。

sentences.en: Only one person had ever crossed the Atlantic in a kayak using solely muscle power, and he traveled island to island, from Newfoundland to Ireland.
sentences.zh: 此前只有一个人仅靠纯粹的人力用皮划艇横渡过大西洋，而且他是从纽芬兰到爱尔兰，岛屿接力着前行的。

sentences.en: Dova's goal was to go continent to continent between the mainlands, from Senegal to Brazil, unsupported.
sentences.zh: 多瓦的目标是从塞内加尔到巴西，在无后援的情况下实现大陆到大陆的横渡。

sentences.en: This time, Dova's trip was far more successful, which is not to say it was pleasant.
sentences.zh: 这一次，多瓦的旅行要成功得多，但这并不是说它很舒适。

sentences.en: The weather was disgusting, humid, and hot.
sentences.zh: 天气糟糕透顶，闷热潮湿。

sentences.en: Dova tried to sleep during the day, but couldn't, so he tried to paddle during the day, and nearly got sunstroke.
sentences.zh: 多瓦试图在白天睡觉，但睡不着，于是他尝试在白天划船，结果差点中暑。

sentences.en: He kept no schedule.
sentences.zh: 他没有制定任何时间表。

sentences.en: I am not German.
sentences.zh: “我不是德国人，”

sentences.en: Always 9 a.m.
sentences.zh: 总是早上9点

sentences.en: paddle, he explained.
sentences.zh: 开始划桨，他解释道。

sentences.en: I am Polish.
sentences.zh: “我是波兰人。

sentences.en: I paddle when I would like.
sentences.zh: 我想什么时候划就什么时候划。”

sentences.en: His skin broke out in salt-induced rashes, including blisters in his armpits and groin.
sentences.zh: 他的皮肤长出了盐分引起的皮疹，包括腋窝和大腿根部的起泡。

sentences.en: His eyes blew up with conjunctivitis.
sentences.zh: 他的眼睛因结膜炎而红肿。

sentences.en: His fingernails and toenails just about peeled off.
sentences.zh: 他的手指甲和脚趾甲几乎都要脱落了。

sentences.en: His clothes, permeated with salt, refused to dry.
sentences.zh: 他的衣服浸透了盐分，怎么也晒不干。

sentences.en: The fabric smelled horrendous and aggravated his skin, so he abandoned clothes.
sentences.zh: 织物散发出难闻的气味，加重了皮肤的不适，于是他索性不穿衣服了。

sentences.en: Ocean kayaking is catastrophically monotonous.
sentences.zh: 海洋皮划艇运动有着灾难般的单调。

sentences.en: The primary challenge is not physical.
sentences.zh: 主要的挑战不是体能上的。

sentences.en: Dova describes the tedium as a form of dementia.
sentences.zh: 多瓦将这种枯燥乏味形容为一种精神错乱。

sentences.en: Hundreds, thousands, maybe millions of repetitions.
sentences.zh: 数百次、数千次，也许数百万次的重复。

sentences.en: The brain is removed from the process.
sentences.zh: 大脑已经退出了这个过程。

sentences.en: Alone at sea without his hearing aids,
sentences.zh: 在海上孤立无援，又没有戴助听器，

sentences.en: Dova joked, he grew so disoriented that he started shouting at himself, so that I could hear.
sentences.zh: 多瓦开玩笑说，他变得如此迷失方向，以至于开始对自己大喊大叫，“这样我才能听到声音”。

sentences.en: Dova is fairly deaf, but didn't bring the aids along because they're expensive and not waterproof, and there was no one to talk to anyway.
sentences.zh: 多瓦的听力相当不好，但没有把助听器带在身边，因为它们很贵又不是防水的，反正也没有人可以说话。

sentences.en: He intended to keep muscle tone in his legs by swimming, but he had to abort that plan because his body in the water attracted sharks.
sentences.zh: 他原本打算通过游泳来保持腿部肌肉的力量，但不得不取消这个计划，因为他在水中的身体会吸引鲨鱼。

sentences.en: He was assaulted by hailstorms of flying fish.
sentences.zh: 他遭到了飞鱼冰雹般的袭击。

sentences.en: Do you know how fast they go?
sentences.zh: “你知道它们游得有多快吗？”

sentences.en: He said.
sentences.zh: 他说。

sentences.en: This does not feel good.
sentences.zh: “这感觉可不好。”

sentences.en: When he couldn't sleep because of the unrelenting stuffiness of his cabin and the waves crashing through the portal onto his head,
sentences.zh: 当他因为小屋里挥之不去的闷热和海浪透过舱口拍打在头上而无法入睡时，

sentences.en: Dova thought about his wife, children, and his young granddaughter.
sentences.zh: 多瓦会想起他的妻子、孩子和小孙女。

sentences.en: He thought about his dead parents.
sentences.zh: 他会想起他死去的父母。

sentences.en: He communed with the turtles, whose shells he tapped while they swam alongside him to make sure they were alive, and the birds, who landed on Olo for a rest
sentences.zh: 他与海龟交流——当海龟游在他身旁时，他会敲敲它们的壳以确保它们还活着；他还与鸟类交流——有些鸟会落在“奥洛”上休息，

sentences.en: and often entered his cabin and did not want to leave.
sentences.zh: 甚至经常钻进他的小屋里不想离开。

sentences.en: He did have a satellite phone, and he texted with Arminski, who, as his trip navigator, sent a regular forecast for wind and weather.
sentences.zh: 他确实有一部卫星电话，并与阿尔明斯基发短信。阿尔明斯基作为他的行程领航员，会定期发送风力和天气预报。

sentences.en: Dova also called his wife twice, but after she got the bill for $500, she says, the desire to talk decreased.
sentences.zh: 多瓦还给妻子打过两次电话，但据说在收到500美元的账单后，通话的欲望就减少了。

sentences.en: Dova rotated through three kinds of freeze-dried porridge for breakfast, four kinds of freeze-dried soup for lunch, and an assortment of a dozen freeze-dried entrees.
sentences.zh: 多瓦轮流吃着三种冷冻干燥的麦片粥作为早餐，四种冷冻干燥的汤作为午餐，以及十几种冷冻干燥的主菜。

sentences.en: He ate all the meat options firSt.
sentences.zh: 他先把所有的肉类选择吃完。

sentences.en: He also snacked on dried fruit and his wife's plum jam, but he ran out of that halfway across the ocean.
sentences.zh: 他还吃一些果干和妻子做的李子果酱作为零食，但在大西洋过半时就吃完了。

sentences.en: Every time he closed his eyes,
sentences.zh: 每当他闭上眼睛，

sentences.en: Dova told me,
sentences.zh: 多瓦告诉我，

sentences.en: I dreamed I was paddling in the winter in Poland.
sentences.zh: “我就会梦见自己在波兰的冬天划船。”

sentences.en: He lost 45 pounds.
sentences.zh: 他瘦了45磅。

sentences.en: Still, the trip was perfect.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，这次旅行依然堪称完美。

sentences.en: 99 days after leaving Senegal,
sentences.zh: 离开塞内加尔99天后，

sentences.en: Dova arrived in Brazil.
sentences.zh: 多瓦抵达了巴西。

sentences.en: He was greeted by one journalist and the Polish ambassador.
sentences.zh: 迎接他的是一位记者和波兰大使。

sentences.en: Nobody cares if you cross the Atlantic in a kayak.
sentences.zh: 没有人会在乎你是否用皮划艇横渡了大西洋。

sentences.en: The fact that Dova knows this is clear in his eyes.
sentences.zh: 多瓦深知这一点，这一点从他的眼神中就能看出来。

sentences.en: In photos from the ends of his trips, he looks ecstatic and feral, in the best possible sense,
sentences.zh: 在他行程结束时的照片中，他看起来欣喜若狂而又野性十足，在最好的意义上来说，

sentences.en: intrinsically wild and free.
sentences.zh: 生来野性而自由。

sentences.en: The day I arrived in Warsaw, a very chic woman named Martina Wojciechowska, the host of a Polish documentary TV show called Woman at the End of the World, showed up at my hotel
sentences.zh: 我到达华沙的那天，一位名叫马蒂娜·沃伊切霍夫斯卡的优雅女性——一档名为《世界尽头的女人》的波兰纪录片节目的主持人——出现在我的酒店里，
zh_words: 马蒂娜·沃伊切霍夫斯卡

sentences.en: to explain Dova to me.
sentences.zh: 向我解读多瓦。

sentences.en: I was not in a great state.
sentences.zh: 我的状态可不太好。

sentences.en: To be precise, I was a Jew with the flu about to go kayaking in Poland in January, not a setup likely to end well.
sentences.zh: 准确地说，我是一个患了流感的犹太人，正准备在一月份去波兰划皮划艇，这绝对不是一个会有好结果的安排。

sentences.en: But still, I was so happy I'd gotten away.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，我还是很高兴自己逃离了这一切。

sentences.en: I'd been feeling buried by stuff exactly as predictable as you'd imagine for a working mother of two kids.
sentences.zh: 我感觉自己被各种琐事淹没，正如你对一个有两个孩子的职场母亲的想象一样，一切都是那么顺理成章。

sentences.en: Honestly, you don't need the details.
sentences.zh: 老实说，你不需要知道具体细节。

sentences.en: Wojciechowska drank a double cappuccino and told me that she'd been engaged five times but never married.
sentences.zh: 沃伊切霍夫斯卡喝着双份卡布奇诺，告诉我她曾订婚五次却从未结婚。

sentences.en: She also left her daughter at age eight months to go climb a mountain in Antarctica because she was trying to complete the seven summits, the highest mountains on each continent,

sentences.en: and achieving that goal at that time felt like a matter of life or death.

sentences.en: The devil, a German man, a Frenchman, and a Polish man are all in a hot air balloon,

sentences.zh: 沃伊切霍夫斯卡说道。

sentences.en: They are falling, falling.
sentences.zh: 他们在下坠，不断下坠。

sentences.en: A catastrophe is about to happen.
sentences.zh: 一场灾难即将发生。

sentences.en: So the devil says to the German man, you must jump.
sentences.zh: 于是魔鬼对德国人说，你必须跳下去。

sentences.zh: 接着魔鬼对法国人说，你必须跳下去。

sentences.en: The Frenchman says, what does this mean?
sentences.zh: 法国人问，这是什么意思？

sentences.en: The devil says, it means that life is meaningless, but when you jump, you will look very chic, very modern.
sentences.zh: 魔鬼说，这意味着生命毫无意义，但当你跳下去的时候，你会显得非常时髦、非常现代。

sentences.en: So the Frenchman jumps.
sentences.zh: 于是法国人也跳了。

sentences.en: Then the devil gets to the Polish man.
sentences.zh: 然后魔鬼找到了波兰人。

sentences.en: He tries the reasons he used on the German and French men without success.
sentences.zh: 他尝试了对德国人和法国人说的那套理由，但毫无效果。

sentences.en: Shoot, the devil says, I know you will not jump.
sentences.zh: ‘见鬼，’魔鬼说，‘我知道你不会跳的。’

sentences.en: And the Polish man jumps.
sentences.zh: 于是波兰人跳了下去。”

sentences.en: Wojciechowska looked at me squarely to make sure I understood.
sentences.zh: 沃伊切霍夫斯卡直视着我，确保我听懂了。

sentences.en: The more you don't believe in Polish people, the more determined we are.
sentences.zh: “你越是不相信波兰人，我们的斗志就越坚定。

sentences.en: To prove themselves,
sentences.zh: 为了证明自己，

sentences.en: Polish people will endure everything.
sentences.zh: 波兰人能够忍受一切。

sentences.en: If you aren't willing to suffer, you can do nothing.
sentences.zh: 如果你不愿承受痛苦，你什么也做不成。

sentences.en: You can sit and die.
sentences.zh: 你只能坐着等死。

sentences.en: This is the only one thing you can do.
sentences.zh: 这是你能做的唯一一件事。”

sentences.en: Doba has a deep, almost performance art-like sense of this.

sentences.en: You can be made small by life or rage against it.
sentences.zh: 你可以被生活变得渺小，或者对它愤怒反抗。

sentences.en: Doba was born in 1946 in Svarjansk, Poland, right after the end of World War II, when the country had been run over by the Soviets and the Germans, then bombed to duSt.
sentences.zh: 多巴于1946年出生在波兰斯瓦夫扬斯克，正值二战结束不久，当时该国先后遭到苏联和德国的蹂躏，随后被炸成废墟。

sentences.en: The whole nation was starving.
sentences.zh: 整个国家都在挨饿。

sentences.en: Previous generations had not fared better.
sentences.zh: 前几代人的境遇并没有更好。

sentences.en: Doba's maternal grandfather, a high-ranking officer in the Tsarist army, was poisoned in the Bolshevik Revolution in 1917.
sentences.zh: 多巴的外祖父是沙皇军队的高级军官，在1917年的布尔什维克革命中被毒害。

sentences.en: His maternal grandmother was sent to Siberia.
sentences.zh: 他的外祖母被流放到了西伯利亚。

sentences.en: Their three sons,
sentences.zh: 他们的三个儿子，

sentences.en: Doba's uncles, disappeared.
sentences.zh: 也就是多巴的舅舅们，失踪了。

sentences.en: And yet,
sentences.zh: 然而，

sentences.en: Doba describes his youth as magical, almost fantastical.
sentences.zh: 多巴形容他的童年充满了神奇色彩，几乎像是在幻境中。

sentences.en: Near his house, he said, there was a pond.
sentences.zh: 他说，他的房子附近有一个池塘。

sentences.en: Behind the pond was a foreSt.
sentences.zh: 池塘后面是一片森林。

sentences.en: In the forest, there were mushrooMs.
sentences.zh: 森林里长满了蘑菇。

sentences.en: And behind all that was a small airport with gliders and storks, which migrated there for the summer.
sentences.zh: 而在这一切的后面是一个小型机场，那里有滑翔机和夏天飞来迁徙的鹳鸟。

sentences.en: Doba's father, a master at building and repairing things from scraps, made his son a bike.
sentences.zh: 多巴的父亲是个用废旧物品拼凑和修理东西的高手，他给儿子做了一辆自行车。

sentences.en: At 15,
sentences.zh: 15岁时，

sentences.zh: 从波兹南

sentences.zh: 遇到了他未来的妻子加布丽埃拉·斯图卡。

sentences.en: He did explain to her how to boil water, which, to this day, she finds ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 他确实向她解释过怎么烧开水，这让她至今觉得荒唐可笑。

sentences.en: But she was charmed by his impish streak, his stories of smuggling ski boots back from East Germany by walking across the border in them, the beard he grew over a summer holiday
sentences.zh: 但她被他调皮的个性所吸引，被他讲述的那些从民主德国走私滑雪靴的故事所吸引——他穿着滑雪靴直接走过边境，还留了一整个暑假的胡子，

sentences.en: so he could return to university and his mandatory military training as the only soldier in Poland with facial hair.
sentences.zh: 这样他就能作为波兰唯一的留胡子士兵回到大学并参加必修的军训。

sentences.en: Doba started kayaking in 1980 after he and Gabriela moved to Polica, where Doba took his equipment repair job at the chemical factory and Gabriela was a social worker.
sentences.zh: 多巴在1980年开始玩皮划艇，当时他和加布丽埃拉搬到了波利察，多巴在化工厂找到了一份设备修理的工作，而加布丽埃拉则是一名社工。

sentences.en: One day, a colleague of Doba's said the factory's kayaking club was going on a two-week expedition.
sentences.zh: 有一天，多巴的一位同事说工厂的皮划艇俱乐部要组织一次为期两周的远征。

sentences.en: Doba had been into hang gliding and skydiving, but the government often closed the airspace because Polica was near the East German border.
sentences.zh: 多巴以前玩过悬挂式滑翔和跳伞，但由于波利察靠近民主德国边境，政府经常关闭空域。

sentences.en: Doba signed up for the factory kayaking trip and went again the following year.
sentences.zh: 多巴报名参加了工厂的皮划艇之旅，第二年又去了。

sentences.en: After, on weekends,
sentences.zh: 此后每逢周末，

sentences.zh: 多巴会把皮划艇装上火车，在尽可能靠近河流的地方下车，然后用一个用自行车和婴儿车零件改装的轮式装置拉着皮划艇

sentences.en: 25 miles, if necessary, to put in.
sentences.zh: 步行长达25英里（如果有必要的话）去下水。

sentences.zh: 有时他会带着年幼的儿子们，

sentences.zh: 巴尔泰克和切希克，分别出生于1979年和1982年。

sentences.zh: 巴尔泰克有点流鼻涕而且很累，但其他都很好，这样她好在他们回来时对比孩子们的状况。

sentences.en: After a while, the boys began to mutiny.
sentences.zh: 过了一段时间，两个男孩开始哗变。

sentences.en: He took us on long trips, only him and us both in the middle of nowhere, and we hated that,
sentences.zh: 他带我们去长途旅行，只有他和我们两个人在荒郊野岭，我们讨厌那样，

sentences.en: Bartek recalled.
sentences.zh: 巴尔泰克回忆道。

sentences.en: It was raining.
sentences.zh: 当时在下雨。

sentences.en: There were spiders.
sentences.zh: 有很多蜘蛛。

sentences.en: There were small rivers and we were squeezing through the bushes.
sentences.zh: 河道很窄，我们得从灌木丛中挤过去。

sentences.en: Freed from the ballast of his sons,
sentences.zh: 摆脱了儿子们的累赘后，

sentences.en: Doba started setting goals for himself.
sentences.zh: 多巴开始为自己设定目标。

sentences.en: Surpassed the record of the greatest number of days paddled by a Polish man in a single year,
sentences.zh: 打破了波兰男子单年在皮划艇上待的天数最多的纪录，

sentences.en: Kayak the longest possible route in Poland,
sentences.zh: 划遍波兰境内最长的路线，

sentences.zh: 在铁幕落下之前，共产党政权宣布在波罗的海划皮划艇为非法，以防有人叛逃。

sentences.en: Doba did anyway.
sentences.zh: 但多巴还是去了。

sentences.zh: 我只是在河里划船，当他无可避免地被抓时，他这样对边防巡逻队说。

sentences.zh: 我不知道我是怎么到这里来的。

sentences.zh: 士兵们告诉多巴，他触犯了太多的法律，他们都不知道该怎么起诉他。

向民主政府的转变称为的那样，

sentences.zh: 多巴的旅行变得更加极端。

sentences.en: He spent 100 days paddling the circumference of the Baltic Sea.
sentences.zh: 他花了100天时间环波罗的海划了一圈。

sentences.en: He kayaked the coast of Norway to the Arctic Circle.
sentences.zh: 他沿着挪威海岸一直划到了北极圈。

sentences.en: Along the way, he was thrown from his kayak in a storm.
sentences.zh: 一路上，他在一场风暴中被甩出了皮划艇。

sentences.en: The rope tethering Doba to the kayak came undone.
sentences.zh: 将多巴和皮划艇系在一起的绳子松开了。

sentences.en: He passed out.
sentences.zh: 他昏了过去。

sentences.en: He woke up on shore to the sound of screaming.
sentences.zh: 他在岸边伴随着尖叫声醒来。

sentences.en: His own.

sentences.en: Doba does not regret this experience.
sentences.zh: 多巴并不后悔这段经历。

sentences.en: He has no interest in dying in his bed.
sentences.zh: 他对死在床上毫无兴趣。

sentences.zh: 一天下午，

sentences.zh: 有时候我们会有去那儿喝杯啤酒的伟大冒险。

sentences.en: Doba's apartment building is a five-story cube of blank concrete with blank concrete stairwells.
sentences.zh: 多巴的公寓楼是一个五层高的光秃秃的混凝土方块，有着光秃秃的混凝土楼梯间。

sentences.en: It looks straight out of a dystopian young adult novel in which the state is intent on creating little gray men.
sentences.zh: 它看起来就像是一部反乌托邦青年小说里的建筑，里面的人一心想要制造千篇一律的灰色小人物。

sentences.en: Shoes in the entrance hall, pencil marks of grandchildren's heights in the kitchen door jam,

sentences.zh: 起居室里的地图册、皮划艇奖杯和印有家庭照片的水晶雪球。

sentences.en: Doba's stinking foam sleeping pad and other gear from Olo remain at Gabriela's request all these months later on the balcony.
sentences.zh: 多巴那散发着恶臭的泡沫防潮垫和来自“奥洛”的其他装备，几个月后的今天依然按照加布丽埃拉的要求放在阳台上。

sentences.en: Even here at home,
sentences.zh: 即使在家里，

sentences.en: Doba's physicality is sui-generous.
sentences.zh: 多巴的体魄也是独一无二的。

sentences.en: His body appears to be assembled from parts belonging to people of vastly different ages.
sentences.zh: 他的身体似乎是由属于截然不同年龄段的人的部位拼凑而成的。

sentences.en: His skin looks 71.
sentences.zh: 他的皮肤看起来像71岁。

sentences.en: His chest looks 50.
sentences.zh: 他的胸膛看起来像50岁。

sentences.zh: 他的双手和前臂看起来像30岁，简直就像蒙大拿州的套牛手。

sentences.zh: 他的头发和胡子看起来像是取自米开朗基罗画作中的上帝。

sentences.en: Gabriela joined us to talk at the dining table, where she had set bowls of peanuts, raisins, chocolates, cookies, and cake, and French presses of coffee and tea.
sentences.zh: 加布丽埃拉加入我们，在餐桌旁坐下聊天，她在桌上摆好了几碗花生、葡萄干、巧克力、饼干和蛋糕，还有法压壶冲泡的咖啡和茶。

sentences.en: At age 64, after 42 years of marriage, she still adores Doba, and her acceptance of him is absolute.

sentences.zh: 加布丽埃拉对多巴生活方式的妥协始于20世纪80年代末，当时多巴沉迷于皮划艇，并开始坚持让加布丽埃拉在圣诞节去她母亲家的路上把他和他的皮划艇

sentences.zh: 按照计划，如果多巴迟到了，

sentences.zh: 在加布丽埃拉向我讲述了圣诞节的事后，

sentences.zh: 多巴开始讲述他的故事。

sentences.zh: 故事始于一段关于礼貌暴政的小型抨击，这种礼貌规定做客的人必须总是说他喜欢主人端上来的所有食物，由此也带来了问题。

sentences.en: You're fed food you don't like again and again.
sentences.zh: 你一遍又一遍地被喂食你根本不喜欢的东西。

sentences.en: The first time I visited my future mother-in-law, she served duck's blood soup.
sentences.zh: 我第一次去拜访我未来的岳母时，她端上来了鸭血汤。

sentences.en: I don't like it at all.
sentences.zh: 我一点也不喜欢它。

sentences.en: I was in a pickle.
sentences.zh: 我陷入了困境。

sentences.en: To avoid the nightmare of quiet conformity,
sentences.zh: 为了避免陷入默默顺从的噩梦，

sentences.zh: 多巴告诉我，他对岳母说，这是一碗好汤。

sentences.zh: 它看起来很好。

sentences.zh: 可能每个人都喜欢它。

sentences.zh: 但唯独这碗汤，我不喜欢。

sentences.en: That was a shock to his mother-in-law, he said, but a short one.

sentences.zh: 她知道我不喜欢。

sentences.zh: 加布丽埃拉并没有为多巴的第一次横渡大西洋远征做好准备。
